value.answer: My pick is the 2026 Kia Carnival Hybrid. The newest review I found, from The Weekly Driver, calls it the best overall minivan for most families, and I agree: it gets 32 mpg combined and has a 10-year/100,000-mile powertrain warranty. Reviewers really do split, though. Edmunds and Car Talk's Ray lean toward the Sienna, U.S. News has the Odyssey on top, and CarGurus ranks the Pacifica first.
